source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: sinus arrest: long PP not an integer multiple; escape may follow.
implementation_basis: Existing fixed authored perfusion inputs, not calibrated stroke volume
invariants: No P/QRS/ejection during the pause; preceding repolarization completes
Optical and vascular finite runoff continues
CVP and Resp artifacts follow surviving events
Indexed lookup and half-open budget atomicity
Shared12-lead and physiology source with wire recovery
limitations: Fixed example without escape, not an automaticity model
Not sinus exit block or complete sick-sinus syndrome
No stroke-volume calibration or gas exchange feedback
